notice: Archived NASA DONKI-inspired context for this offline classroom game. Event timing and gameplay values are simplified; they are not a forecast or a radiation-safety tool.

sources.name: NASA CCMC DONKI
sources.use: Solar flares, coronal mass ejections, and solar energetic particle events.

sources.name: NASA lunar radiation background
sources.use: The Moon has no thick atmosphere or global magnetic field to protect astronauts.

events.title: Solar flare alert
events.kid_message: NASA watches flares from the Sun. Put the crew inside, or spend battery power on the shield.

events.title: Solar cloud warning
events.kid_message: A cloud from the Sun may arrive soon. You have a little time to prepare the base.

events.title: Fast particle alert
events.kid_message: Fast particles can reach the Moon. Outside jobs stop until the alert is over.
